newsitem.title: USA: Texaco California crude pipeline remains shut.
newsitem.headline: Texaco California crude pipeline remains shut.

text.p: Texaco Inc said on Wednesday a portion of its California crude oil pipeline between Bakersfield and San Francisco remained under repair after rupturing Tuesday.
"24 hours is what we expected (for repairs) and I haven't heard any new reports," a company spokeswoman said.
Early Tuesday, a 50-mile portion of the line shut automatically and spilled about 1,000 barrels of heavy crude oil from San Joaquin Valley oilfields in California.
Clean up on the spill was nearly complete, the spokeswoman said.
The pipeline has a 20-inch diamater and a daily throughput of 340,000 barrels. The shut portion carries 120,000 barrels a day.
